note: Text for the (i) info button of each setting, column, notice and report added by RPT-B1. English; the three-mode versions follow the usual dictionary.

entries.title: Report cost basis
entries.what_it_does: Chooses where item sales, category sales, sales summary, combined sales and the business page take the cost of goods from.
entries.why_it_matters: Two cost bases made the same item show "-" in one report and a margin in another. One setting makes them agree.
entries.default: price_list: only the cost typed in the item master, exactly as before.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: ledger_first: the cost from the stock ledger (what the goods really cost) first; the typed cost only where the ledger has none, and that part is called an estimate. Lines with no cost anywhere stay empty, never 0.
entries.who_can_change: Only the owner (Settings).

entries.title: How many top customers are listed
entries.what_it_does: Number of customers shown in "What the top customers buy".
entries.why_it_matters: Keeps the list short enough for a phone.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A number from 1 to 200 changes the length of the list.
entries.who_can_change: Only the owner (Settings).

entries.title: Sales figures are net of sale returns (existing setting, now also used here)
entries.what_it_does: The new "after returns" columns, the festival comparison and the top-customer list follow this setting.
entries.why_it_matters: One rule for every report.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Off: the "after returns" columns equal the old columns and a note says returns are shown only for information.
entries.who_can_change: Only the owner (Settings).

entries.title: One profit number (existing setting)
entries.what_it_does: Not changed. The branch profit reports now NAME the losses (wastage, count shrink, transit loss, cash short) that are left out while it is off.
entries.why_it_matters: The owner sees what is missing before deciding.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: On: those losses are counted in the profit and are no longer named as left out.
entries.who_can_change: Only the owner (Settings).

entries.title: Returns
entries.what_it_does: Value of goods taken back in the period (the sale discount share already taken off), counted on the day of the return.
entries.why_it_matters: The same day showed two different sales figures because returns were ignored.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Sales after returns
entries.what_it_does: Sales minus returns. Equals the dashboard figure. With the setting "net of returns" off it equals Sales.
entries.why_it_matters: Lets the sales reports agree with the dashboard and the profit reports.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Returned quantity
entries.what_it_does: Quantity taken back, per item.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows how many pieces really stayed sold.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Quantity after returns
entries.what_it_does: Quantity sold minus quantity returned.
entries.why_it_matters: The quantity that stayed sold.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Refunds paid out
entries.what_it_does: Money handed back to customers for sale returns, by payment mode and day. A return settled against a customer due is not a payout.
entries.why_it_matters: Cash that left the drawer must be visible in the payment report.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Amount after refunds
entries.what_it_does: Amount taken by the mode minus refunds paid out by the same mode.
entries.why_it_matters: The real money by payment mode.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Cash refunds paid out
entries.what_it_does: POS day close: cash handed back to customers that day.
entries.why_it_matters: The drawer cash was shown too high because refunds were ignored.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Expected cash in drawer after refunds
entries.what_it_does: POS day close: expected cash minus cash refunds. The old "expected cash" column is unchanged.
entries.why_it_matters: This is the figure to compare with the counted drawer.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Actual measured?
entries.what_it_does: Raw material report: measured, partly or not captured.
entries.why_it_matters: The report used to show 0.00 % difference although nothing was measured.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Conversion cost not captured
entries.what_it_does: Costing runs: shows "Not costed" when the place method is off (no 0).
entries.why_it_matters: A zero looked like a real cost.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Actual cost not captured
entries.what_it_does: Costing runs: shows "Not captured" when no actual yield was typed (no copy of the standard).
entries.why_it_matters: Actual equal to standard was misleading.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Losses left out of the profit (gaps column)
entries.what_it_does: Branch profit reports name wastage, count shrink, transit loss and cash short/over that exist but are not counted.
entries.why_it_matters: The profit looked complete when it was not.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Cannot be switched off. Old columns are unchanged.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Daily sell-out / unsold at closing
entries.what_it_does: Per day, outlet and item: opening, produced, received, returned, sold, wasted, sent, other, what is left at closing, sell-through % and the cost of the wastage. Tap a row for the stock movements behind it.
entries.why_it_matters: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Festival / season comparison
entries.what_it_does: The same items over the chosen dates against the same dates one year earlier (or other dates in "Compare with"). Says "no previous data" when nothing was sold then. Tap a row for the sales.
entries.why_it_matters: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: What the top customers buy
entries.what_it_does: The top customers by sales (after returns) and their items. Walk-in sales without a customer are counted and named. Tap a row for the sales.
entries.why_it_matters: Answers a question a sweets business asks and no existing report answers.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.

entries.title: Reports map
entries.what_it_does: Lists the 14 sections of the report master list: the state of every report and one link to open it. Static list from the audits.
entries.why_it_matters: One place to see what exists, what is incomplete and what is missing.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Open to the roles that already hold the report group right. Read-only.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone who may open the report.
